images.caption: Mine ruins consisting of a single wall and fenced-off hollow, surrounded by an expanse of old mine debris and spoil heaps, a few hundred meters to the south of the small cove at Chapel Porth. National Trust. Quite a climb up to it but the view across the cove towards Wheal Coates is well worth it.
